label: GOD_4 is one from a maximal bearer excluding distinct esse causes
meaning: With one MAXIME_1 witness m, each GOD_4 distinct from m would give m its esse in CAUSE_2. Exclusion forbids this, so an identity split yields equality with m for every God. The auxiliary theorem needs only CausesAllInGenus for each God at esse since m is in act there. The registered input is the existing carrier-wide converse. No God is supplied.
